translations.web: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
translations.bsb: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.
translations.kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
translations.asv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
